title: Effective Trim Materials
description: Add beneficial effects to trimmed armor based on the trim material.
body:
A simple take on Trim effects that alter player attributes for the most part.
## Trim Effects
- Iron: +1 armor
- Copper: +1 attack knockback
- Emerald: +10 safe fall distance
- Redstone: +1 step height
- Quartz: +1 attack damage
- Lapis: 25% increased xp
- Amethyst: +0.25 attack speed
- Diamond: +15% speed
- Netherite: +4 health. Full set: +2 health.
- Gold: Apparently useless. Using a full gold trimmed armor might have a bonus.

## Misc
All the trim effect info is available in all armor smithing templates tooltips.

The mod could use a config to modify effects and add materials, I'll try to improve it in the future
